p: Verb - Pual - Perfect - third person common plural
d: properly, to chop into, pierce or sever; hence, to curtail, to distribute (into ranks); to shoot an arrow
j: archer, [idiom] bands, cut off in the midst.
r: a primitive root (compare H2673 (חָצָה)lemma חָעָה ayin, corrected to חָצָה); also as denominative from H2671 (חֵץ)
